title: The Fatima Center - Videos
description:
Our mission is to ensure that the entire Fatima Message is fully known, understood, and obeyed.

Founded in 1978, The Fatima Center is a grassroots association of Catholic priests and lay people. The Director of The Fatima Center since then was Father Nicholas Gruner († 2015).
